articles.title: Nations that build their own weapons write their Destiny, says Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh flagged off the first batch of Suryastra Universal Rocket Launchers from Nibe Ltd's new Shirdi facility, inducting them into the Indian Army. This significant development boosts indigenous defence production and modernizes the Army's capabilities. The Suryastra launchers enhance India's self-reliance in advanced rocket technology, strengthening national security and operational readiness.

articles.title: Minda Corp Q4 profit surges 138% to ₹124 crore on strong demand
articles.summary: Minda Corporation reported its strongest-ever quarterly and annual financial performance in FY26. This significant achievement was driven by increasing electronics content in vehicles, growing premiumisation trends, and robust demand across the two-wheeler segment. The results reflect India's dynamic automotive manufacturing sector and evolving consumer preferences, showcasing industrial growth.

articles.title: SPIC Q4 profit up on better cost control
articles.summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Ltd (SPIC) reported a consolidated net profit of ₹29.5 crore for the quarter ended March 2026 (Q4FY26). This represents a notable increase compared to the ₹19.5 crore profit recorded in the same quarter of the previous fiscal year. This financial performance indicates positive growth for the petrochemical company during the period.

articles.title: Future wars will be multi-domain with cyber and cognitive aspects, says CDS Gen Anil Chauhan
articles.summary: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan highlighted that future wars will be multi-domain, encompassing land, sea, air, cyberspace, and cognitive warfare operating synergistically. He stressed the pivotal role of technology and speed in these evolving conflicts. SSB aspirants should grasp this shift towards integrated, complex battlefields, emphasizing the need for comprehensive understanding of modern warfare strategies and technological advancements for effective defence preparedness.

articles.title: A nation that manufactures its own weaponry writes its own destiny: Raksha Mantri
articles.summary: The Defence Minister and Maharashtra CM inaugurated India's first private sector Defence Manufacturing Complex in Shirdi. This landmark facility is set to produce advanced systems, notably India's first 300 KM Universal Rocket Launching System. This initiative significantly bolsters indigenous defence production capabilities, enhances self-reliance (Aatmanirbharta) in defence, and contributes to national security and job creation.

articles.title: Vinesh Phogat to participate in Asian Games selection trials: Delhi High Court
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has permitted celebrated grappler Vinesh Phogat to participate in the upcoming Asian Games trials, overriding the Wrestling Federation of India's (WFI) decision. This crucial ruling ensures a fair opportunity for a top athlete to contend for a spot, emphasizing judicial oversight in sports administration for upholding athlete rights and ensuring due process.

articles.title: Indian stock market under FPI selling pressure: What should domestic retail investors do now? Experts weigh in
articles.summary: Foreign investors are continuously pulling funds from Indian equities due to multiple economic headwinds. Key factors include elevated global crude oil prices, persistent domestic inflationary pressures, weak earnings prospects for Indian companies, and the depreciating rupee. This trend reflects growing concerns over India's economic stability and financial market performance, impacting overall investor confidence.

articles.title: High Court Clears Vinesh Phogat For Asian Games Trials
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has allowed wrestler Vinesh Phogat to compete in the Asian Games trials, challenging the Wrestling Federation of India’s exclusionary selection policy. This decision ensures fairness in athlete selection, overruling previous restrictions. It highlights the judiciary's role in upholding sports integrity and providing equal opportunities for national representation at major international events.
